what: At the very top the header row, spread at 99% of the window width, shrinks into a centered 60rem (16rem below 1024) pill in .6s power4.out after just 10px of scroll, and at that moment a pale surface-color panel (90%·80% at 1280 and above) with a 10px blur is laid beneath. Returning to the top spreads it again with the same curve and the panel clears. With hide set, the header row retracts upward while scrolling down past that (112px at 1024 and above · 64px below, 1s cubic-bezier(.135,.9,.15,1)) and drops back with any upward scroll (original 400px)

options.at: Scroll (px) at which it becomes a pill, default 10
options.hide: While scrolled below this (px), the header line is retracted, default 0 (off) — original 400

use: Logo · Menu · Button
note: The original re-applies the same tween on every scroll event — the result is the same, so it is applied only when the state · width step changes. The panel color is a semi-transparent surface color (--kf-surface), so a dark skin gives a dark pill. To use the walk curve with exact numbers, load CustomEase first.

from.where: shared.js header bar .ms-head (logo·menu·day/night button·”Start a Project”)
